card.name: Words just before a treatment or agent term
card.fires_on: Small words or word starts right before an expected treatment or substance word, such as 'with' before peat, 'be' before treated, or 'inhal' in inhalation. Seen in drug labels and poisoning or soil-treatment text.

modes.label: Linking word before treatment
modes.description: A short word like with, be, or an that comes just before a named treatment, antidote or agent.

modes.description: The opening piece of a longer medical word such as inhalation or extracellular, often inside an inhaled drug name.
